About us

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy. 

FUNCTION: Engineering

We are seeking an experienced Information Security Manager to join our Security team.

The Information Security Manager at BVNK is instrumental in establishing and maintaining a robust framework for managing operational risks related to information security with a strong emphasis on compliance with Brazilian financial regulations. The primary focus will be the establishment and implementation of the necessary changes to the global frameworks, documentation and workflows to ensure compliance with local regulations. This involves identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across business processes, technology platforms, third-party engagements, and regulatory compliance requirements. The Manager will collaborate across the organization, ensuring operational resilience and alignment with the overall risk appetite and security strategy.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

Brazil License & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the modification and implementation of changes to the global information security operational risk and ICT control framework required to support the application for and maintenance of the Brazilian VASP financial license under BCB Resolution 520/25.
  • Coordinate with local legal representatives, external counsel, and regulatory authorities (including the Central Bank of Brazil) to ensure information security policies and operational resilience mechanisms remain fully compliant with Brazilian regulatory standards.
  • Oversee the creation of the necessary technical controls, their implementation and continuous operation, including reporting and monitoring.

Risk Identification and Assessment

  • Update and manage the information security operational risk register, ensuring accurate classification, measurement, and reporting of identified risks.
  • Conduct regular operational ICT risk assessments across critical business processes, IT systems, and applications to identify control weaknesses and potential impact scenarios.
  • Collaborate with business process owners to integrate ICT risk controls and ensure adherence to the 'three lines of defense' model.
  • Integrate and monitor internal fraud controls specifically related to IT systems, processes, and privileged access, establishing necessary detection and prevention mechanisms.

Audits and Compliance Management

  • Support internal and external audit processes, including collecting evidence, managing audit requests, and ensuring continuous compliance with regulatory standards.

Risk Mitigation and Control Management

  • Design, implement, and monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) for IT security controls and processes.
  • Facilitate the control self-assessment process, verifying the existence and effectiveness of security controls across the organization.

Investigations, Policies, and Training

  • Investigate and create comprehensive reports regarding fraud cases, security incidents, and privacy violations, ensuring timely follow-up on remediation measures.
  • Conduct operational risk reviews of client processes and tools, presenting recommendations on identified security gaps and creating initiatives for fraud prevention.
  • Develop new documents for Security Related Policies and update current policies.
  • Create new documents for other departments related to Security or information security topics.

What we need from you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in operational risk management, IT risk, IT audit, or information security governance roles.
  • Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or similar are highly desirable.
  • Experience with SOC 1 and Vanta will be considered a strong plus.
  • Experience and deep knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory standards related to information security in the financial sector.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and maintain an operational risk framework, ideally within an information security context.
  • Strong understanding of security controls, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) principles.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on translating technical risks into business context.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, capable of influencing stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Proficiency in utilising GRC tools and platforms for risk and control management.

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

About the role

We are seeking a Technical Writer to own end-to-end developer documentation for Bitdeer AI's MaaS platform, spanning API reference, getting-started guides, and release notes for a fast-moving catalog of hosted chat, completion, embedding, and fine-tuning endpoints. Today, developers integrating against our inference API frequently have to reverse-engineer request and response shapes from internal Postman collections, ask engineering directly in Slack, or discover breaking parameter changes only after their integration fails in production, which slows time-to-first-successful-call and generates avoidable support load on the engineering team. This role fixes that by turning our OpenAPI specifications, model catalog, and endpoint behavior into accurate, versioned, always-current documentation that developers can trust as the single source of truth, and by establishing a release notes cadence that keeps pace with model and endpoint updates. The person who succeeds here is comfortable reading Go service code and API diffs well enough to write precisely about them, treats documentation as a product with its own release cycle rather than an afterthought, and can work independently across multiple engineering teams to pull accurate technical detail out of people who are not naturally inclined to write it down themselves.

What you will be responsible for:

  • API Reference Ownership: Maintain and continuously improve the OpenAPI-driven API reference covering chat/completions, embeddings, fine-tuning, and model routing endpoints. Verify that documented request/response schemas, error codes, and rate limits match actual service behavior by testing against staging and production endpoints. Work directly with backend engineers to capture new parameters, deprecations, and behavioral edge cases before they ship to customers.
  • Getting-Started and Onboarding Guides: Design and maintain the guides that take a new developer from signing up to making their first successful inference call, including authentication, SDK quickstarts, and common integration patterns across supported languages. Continuously identify drop-off points in the onboarding funnel through support tickets and developer feedback, and rewrite the weakest steps first. Keep sample code runnable and tested against the live API rather than left to go stale.
  • Release Notes and Changelog Discipline: Establish and run a recurring release notes process tied to model catalog updates, new endpoints, pricing changes, and breaking API changes, so developers are never surprised by a change in production. Coordinate with product and engineering release cadences to publish notes before or at the moment of rollout, and clearly flag deprecations, migration steps, and timelines for removal.
  • Docs-as-Code Pipeline and Information Architecture: Own the documentation toolchain (Markdown/MDX, Git-based review, OpenAPI spec linting and generation) so that docs are versioned, reviewable, and testable the same way code is. Organize the growing surface area of models, endpoints, and guides into an information architecture that stays navigable as the model catalog expands. Reduce duplicated or contradictory content across reference, guides, and internal wikis.
  • Cross-functional Technical Fact-Finding: Interview engineers, PMs, and support staff to extract accurate technical detail on new features, model behavior quirks, and known limitations, and turn ad hoc knowledge into structured, discoverable documentation. Sit in on model launch and API design reviews early enough to document decisions and rationale, not just final syntax, and push back when proposed APIs or error messages would be confusing to document or to use.
  • Developer Feedback Loop: Instrument and monitor documentation usage signals (search queries with no results, support tickets referencing missing or wrong docs, doc page feedback) to prioritize what to fix next. Report recurring documentation gaps back to engineering and product as a proxy for API usability issues, not just writing quality issues.

How you will stand out:

  • Bring 5+ years of professional technical writing experience with at least 2 years focused on API or SDK documentation for a developer-facing product, ideally at an API-first, infrastructure, or cloud/AI platform company.
  • Demonstrate hands-on experience authoring and maintaining OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and generating reference documentation from them, rather than hand-writing reference docs from scratch.
  • Show a portfolio of published getting-started guides, quickstarts, or tutorials that took a developer from zero to a working integration, with clear evidence you wrote (not just edited) the technical content.
  • Have working familiarity with a docs-as-code toolchain: Markdown/MDX, Git-based version control and pull request review, and static site generators or documentation platforms (e.g., Docusaurus, Mintlify, ReadMe, GitBook, or equivalent).
  • Be comfortable reading code (Go, Python, or TypeScript) and API traces well enough to verify documentation accuracy independently, without waiting on engineering to hand you finished specs.
  • Have experience running a release notes or changelog process for a product that ships frequently, including coordinating publish timing with engineering release cycles.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, colour, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

About Crossmint

Global financial rails are undergoing a once-in-a-generation transformation. Instant settlement. Programmable. Agent-first. Crossmint is the infrastructure helping companies build for that future.

We are the leading all-in-one stablecoin and wallet infrastructure platform, enabling fintechs, enterprises, and agentic platforms to integrate stablecoin rails with speed, compliance, and scale. Crossmint provides everything enterprises need to ship smart financial rails, including smart wallets, cross-chain stablecoin orchestration, on/offramps, token checkout, and more, all through a single developer-friendly API.

Trusted by more than 40,000 clients including global leaders like MoneyGram, Western Union, and Paga to nation states like the Marshall Islands, Crossmint powers stablecoin flows that move billions from cross-border remittances, global payroll, to the world's first digital UBI program.

MiCA-authorized, PSD2-licensed, and SOC2 Type II certified, Crossmint serves 150+ countries globally across 50+ blockchains. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Franklin Templeton, NYCA, First Round, and Lightspeed Faction.

We're building the infrastructure for the era of programmable finance. Join us!

Location

New York, New York.

Type of employment

Full-time, indefinite contract

Seniority

3+ years of experience

Compensation

Base salary range: $225,000 - $250,000

Note: This range reflects base salary only. Final level, team assignment, and compensation are determined during the interview process based on experience and fit.

About The Role

Wallets sit at the center of everything Crossmint does. Every stablecoin payment, payout, and agentic transaction our clients run goes through our smart-wallet stack, which today spans EVM, Solana, and Stellar and serves enterprises like MoneyGram, OpenSea, and the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

As Engineering Lead for Wallets, you'll own the technical direction of that infrastructure end to end. You'll set the roadmap, make the key architectural calls, and lead a team of six engineers while continuing to write and ship production code yourself.

You'll work closely with Product, GTM, and Customer Success Engineering to turn enterprise requirements into on-chain primitives, and you'll represent the team in conversations with partners and vendors. This is a hands-on leadership role based in our New York office.

What You Will Do

  • Serving as Engineering Lead for the Wallets team, owning the full technical roadmap and strategy for Crossmint's programmable smart-wallet infrastructure across EVM, Solana, and Stellar blockchains.

  • Driving end-to-end architectural design and delivery of on-chain wallet primitives including smart-contract signers, recovery signers, delegated signer scopes/permissions, gas sponsorship, wallet creation billing, device signers, and multi-chain transaction orchestration via Temporal distributed workflows.

  • Leading the technical direction for wallet products serving enterprise clients such as MoneyGram, Marshall Islands (UBI program), OpenSea, and Robinhood Chain, as well as agentic-payments customers integrating Crossmint's wallet stack with Mastercard, Cloudflare, and AWS Agent Core Payments.

  • Coordinating directly with the GTM, CSE, and Product teams to align wallet roadmap priorities with commercial requirements, including defining differentiation positioning around on-chain programmability, no-vendor-lock-in architecture, and enterprise-grade stablecoin product integration.

  • Establishing and enforcing engineering best practices for the team: code quality standards, PR review guidelines, AI-assisted development workflows using Devin, structured sprint planning, retro action items, and technical documentation.

  • Setting up and maintaining observability infrastructure including Datadog dashboards for endpoint success rates, latency, and transaction throughput across all wallet-related services.

  • Managing a team of 6 direct reports across seniority levels (2 senior contractors, 2 senior engineers, 2 mid-level engineers), overseeing onboarding, performance coaching, and technical mentoring.

  • Representing the wallets team in cross-functional planning, product status updates, architectural reviews, and external vendor/partner technical calls (Temporal, ZeroDev, Phala, Alchemy, Rain).

  • Actively contributing production code: designing and merging complex PRs spanning wallet signer authorization, EVM UserOperation bundler flows, Solana fee estimation, Stellar V2 smart contract infrastructure, card-collateral topup workflows, and SDK bug fixes across web and mobile (React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Flutter).

Telecommuting permitted up to 1 day/week.

What We Are Looking For

Must-haves

Crossmint will accept three (3) years of experience in the job offered or in a Full-Stack Engineer or Engineering Lead-related occupation.

Position requires demonstrable experience in the following:

  • TypeScript: designing scalable, production-grade full-stack applications and decentralized wallet interfaces, including high-performance React integrations.

  • Developing resilient backend services using NestJS, distributed task orchestration via Temporal workers, blockchain data processing, and real-time event handling.

  • Building, auditing, and deploying Solidity and Stellar/Soroban smart contracts in production environments, ensuring compliance with security standards and gas-optimization best practices (including Halborn/Latacora audit remediation).

  • Designing and maintaining multi-chain blockchain infrastructure components across EVM (Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base), Solana, and Stellar: smart-contract factories, event indexers, webhook pipelines, and on-chain/off-chain data systems.

  • Designing and deploying monitoring, observability, and fault-tolerant solutions using Datadog and Temporal to ensure system resilience and high throughput at scale.

  • Leading and mentoring engineering teams including conducting technical interviews, defining best-practice standards, and driving code quality through structured review processes.

  • Managing distributed AI-assisted engineering workflows (Devin) to accelerate delivery while maintaining architecture integrity and code quality.

Why Join Crossmint?

  • Build regulated infrastructure at scale. We're one of the few stablecoin infrastructure providers licensed under MiCA across all 27 EU member states, and the wallets you build will move real money for global enterprises.

  • Work on products with real-world impact. Our stack powers MoneyGram's stablecoin cross-border experience in LATAM and the Marshall Islands' national digital UBI program.

  • Own what you build. We're a team of around 80 people, so your technical decisions shape the product directly, with no layers between you and the people using it.

  • Stay at the frontier. You'll work on agentic payments with partners like Mastercard, Cloudflare, and AWS, along with multichain infrastructure across EVM, Solana, and Stellar.

  • Join a global team. We have offices in New York, Miami, Madrid, and Buenos Aires, and we're backed by Ribbit Capital, Franklin Templeton, NYCA, First Round, and Lightspeed Faction.

Benefits

  • Extensive access to leading AI tools and subscriptions, with AI actively encouraged and integrated into daily workflows.

  • Unlimited, flexible PTO.

  • Parental Leave program.

  • Flexible work schedule.

  • Company laptop and allowance for any necessary home equipment.

  • Daily stipend for commuting to the office and/or meals.

  • Two company-paid off-sites each year.

  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term disability (STD), and long-term disability (LTD) insurances.

  • 401(k) Plan.

Our Principles

  • Results and delivery: Ship high quality work fast.

  • Build for the long term: Build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. Use AI.

  • Extreme Ownership: Be an effective Directly Responsible Individual (DRI). Be proactive.

  • Be a team player: Be an effective and kind colleague providing credible challenge. Be present and reliable.
